description: Search the community's AI workflows offline, and rank them by week - two things the site's own API cannot do.

novel_features.name: Time-windowed top workflows
novel_features.description: Rank the highest-upvoted workflows inside a time window like 7d or 30d.

novel_features.name: Use-case finder
novel_features.description: Answer 'are there any workflows for X' by blending the server's semantic search with local full-text search, then ranking by upvotes.

novel_features.name: Full workflow reader
novel_features.description: Print one workflow in full - body, tools, industries, author and comments - in a single call.

novel_features.name: Community digest
novel_features.description: Summarise a time window: how many workflows landed, the top posts, the most-used tools and the busiest authors.

novel_features.name: Tool adoption ranking
novel_features.description: Rank AI tools by how often they appear in workflows and by the upvotes those workflows earned.

novel_features.name: Tool co-occurrence stacks
novel_features.description: Show which other tools appear alongside a given tool, so you can see the stacks people really run.
